title: Powers of i cycle with period four

board_content.text: To evaluate $i^{n}$, divide $n$ by 4 and keep only the remainder.
For negative powers, add a multiple of 4 first: $i^{-1}=i^{3}=-i$.
Any four consecutive powers of $i$ add to zero — a huge shortcut for long sums.

segments_english.text: From the rotation picture, the powers of i can only ever be four things, and they repeat in a cycle.
Here is the cycle: i to the one is i, i squared is minus one, i cubed is minus i, and i to the fourth is back to one.

Writing that generally: i to the power four k is one, four k plus one gives i, four k plus two gives minus one, and four k plus three gives minus i. The exponent's remainder on division by four is all that matters.
So to evaluate any power of i, you don't compute the whole thing. You just divide the exponent by four and keep the remainder.
Take i to the one hundred thirty five. One hundred thirty five is four times thirty three plus three, so the remainder is three, and i to the one hundred thirty five equals i cubed equals minus i.
For a negative exponent, add a multiple of four to make it positive first. So i to the minus one becomes i cubed, which is minus i.
And here is a gorgeous fact worth memorizing: any four consecutive powers of i sum to zero.
Why? Factor out the first one and you're left with one plus i plus i squared plus i cubed, which is one plus i minus one minus i, exactly zero. Use this to collapse long sums instantly.

segments_hinglish.text: Rotation wali picture se i ki powers sirf chaar cheezein ho sakti hain, aur wo ek cycle mein repeat hoti hain.
Ye rahi cycle: i to the one is i, i squared is minus one, i cubed is minus i, aur i to the fourth wapas one.

Generally likhein to: i to the power four k is one, four k plus one deta hai i, four k plus two deta hai minus one, aur four k plus three deta hai minus i. Sirf exponent ka remainder, four se divide karke, matter karta hai.
To i ki koi bhi power nikaalne ke liye poora calculate mat karo. Bas exponent ko four se divide karo aur remainder rakho.
Lo i to the one hundred thirty five. One hundred thirty five is four times thirty three plus three, to remainder three, aur i to the one hundred thirty five equals i cubed equals minus i.
Negative exponent ke liye pehle four ka multiple add karke positive banao. To i to the minus one ban jaata hai i cubed, yaani minus i.
Aur ye ek khoobsurat fact hai yaad rakhne layak: i ki koi bhi four consecutive powers add hoke zero ban jaati hain.
Kyun? Pehli power factor out karo, bachta hai one plus i plus i squared plus i cubed, jo hai one plus i minus one minus i, bilkul zero. Isse lambe sums turant collapse karo.
